verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃ שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֭את כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינוּ כָּל־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ miz·mō·wr šim·‘ū- zōṯ kāl- hā·‘am·mîm ha·’ă·zî·nū kāl- yō·šə·ḇê ḥā·leḏ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of the sons of Korah Hear this all you peoples . . . listen all inhabitants of the world
verses.literalPt: Ouvi isto, todos os povos; dai ouvidos, todos os habitantes do mundo,

verses.original: גַּם־ בְּנֵ֣י אָ֭דָם גַּם־ בְּנֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ יַ֝֗חַד עָשִׁ֥יר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: gam- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām gam- bə·nê- ’îš ya·ḥaḏ ‘ā·šîr wə·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: both low and high . . . . . . . . . . . . rich and poor alike
verses.literalPt: tanto plebeus como de alta estirpe, juntamente os ricos e os pobres.

verses.original: פִּ֭י יְדַבֵּ֣ר חָכְמ֑וֹת וְהָג֖וּת לִבִּ֣י תְבוּנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: pî yə·ḏab·bêr ḥā·ḵə·mō·wṯ wə·hā·ḡūṯ lib·bî ṯə·ḇū·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: My mouth will impart wisdom and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding
verses.literalPt: A minha boca falará sabedoria; de entendimento será a meditação do meu coração.

verses.original: אַטֶּ֣ה לְמָשָׁ֣ל אָזְנִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֥ח בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר חִידָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aṭ·ṭeh lə·mā·šāl ’ā·zə·nî ’ep̄·taḥ bə·ḵin·nō·wr ḥî·ḏā·ṯî
verses.literal: I will incline my ear to a proverb I will express my riddle with the harp
verses.literalPt: Inclinarei o meu ouvido a uma parábola; ao som da harpa, declararei o meu enigma.

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה אִ֭ירָא בִּ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עֲוֺ֖ן עֲקֵבַ֣י יְסוּבֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ’î·rā bî·mê rā‘ ‘ă·wōn ‘ă·qê·ḇay yə·sū·bê·nî
verses.literal: Why should I fear in times of trouble when wicked usurpers surround me
verses.literalPt: Por que hei de eu temer nos dias de adversidade, quando me cercar a iniquidade dos que me perseguem,

verses.original: הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים עַל־ חֵילָ֑ם וּבְרֹ֥ב עָ֝שְׁרָ֗ם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bō·ṭə·ḥîm ‘al- ḥê·lām ū·ḇə·rōḇ ‘ā·šə·rām yiṯ·hal·lā·lū
verses.literal: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches
verses.literalPt: dos que confiam na sua fazenda e se gloriam na multidão das suas riquezas?

verses.original: אָ֗ח לֹא־ פָדֹ֣ה יִפְדֶּ֣ה אִ֑ישׁ לֹא־ יִתֵּ֖ן לֵאלֹהִ֣ים כָּפְרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āḥ lō- p̄ā·ḏōh yip̄·deh ’îš lō- yit·tên lê·lō·hîm kā·p̄ə·rōw
verses.literal: No man can possibly redeem . . . his brother or pay his ransom to God
verses.literalPt: Nenhum deles pode de maneira alguma remir a seu irmão, nem por ele dar um resgate a Deus

verses.original: וְ֭יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְחָדַ֥ל לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·qar piḏ·yō·wn nap̄·šām wə·ḥā·ḏal lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: For the redemption of his soul is costly and never can payment suffice
verses.literalPt: (Pois custa demais a remissão da vida deles, e esta tentativa tem de ser abandonada para sempre.),

verses.original: וִֽיחִי־ ע֥וֹד לָנֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַשָּֽׁחַת׃
verses.transliteration: wî·ḥî- ‘ō·wḏ lā·ne·ṣaḥ lō yir·’eh haš·šā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: that he should live on . . . forever and not see decay
verses.literalPt: para que continuasse a viver perpetuamente e para que não visse a cova.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה׀ חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָבַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְעָזְב֖וּ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî yir·’eh ḥă·ḵā·mîm yā·mū·ṯū ya·ḥaḏ kə·sîl wā·ḇa·‘ar yō·ḇê·ḏū wə·‘ā·zə·ḇū la·’ă·ḥê·rîm ḥê·lām
verses.literal: For it is clear that wise men die and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others
verses.literalPt: Pois vê-se que os sábios morrem; o estulto e o estúpido juntos perecem e deixam a outros a sua fazenda.

verses.original: קִרְבָּ֤ם בָּתֵּ֨ימוֹ׀ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר קָֽרְא֥וּ בִ֝שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: qir·bām bāt·tê·mōw lə·‘ō·w·lām miš·kə·nō·ṯām lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr qā·rə·’ū ḇiš·mō·w·ṯām ‘ă·lê ’ă·ḏā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Their graves are their eternal homes their dwellings for endless generations . . . even though their lands were their namesakes . . .
verses.literalPt: O seu pensamento íntimo é que as suas casas permanecerão para sempre, e as suas moradas, para todas as gerações. Eles dão às suas terras os seus próprios nomes.

verses.original: וְאָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר בַּל־ יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḏām bî·qār bal- yā·lîn nim·šal kab·bə·hê·mō·wṯ niḏ·mū
verses.literal: But a man despite his wealth cannot endure he is like the beasts that perish
verses.literalPt: O homem, porém, não permanece em dignidade; antes, é semelhante aos animais que perecem.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑מוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֓ם׀ בְּפִיהֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: zeh ḏar·kām kê·sel lā·mōw wə·’a·ḥă·rê·hem bə·p̄î·hem yir·ṣū se·lāh
verses.literal: This is the fate of the foolish and their followers who endorse their sayings Selah
verses.literalPt: Este é o caminho dos que confiam em si mesmos e o dos que os seguem, aplaudindo o que eles dizem. (Selá)

verses.original: כַּצֹּ֤אן׀ לִֽשְׁא֣וֹל שַׁתּוּ֮ מָ֤וֶת יִ֫רְעֵ֥ם וַיִּרְדּ֘וּ בָ֤ם יְשָׁרִ֨ים׀ לַבֹּ֗קֶר וְצִירָם לְבַלּ֥וֹת שְׁא֗וֹל מִזְּבֻ֥ל לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kaṣ·ṣōn liš·’ō·wl šat·tū mā·weṯ yir·‘êm way·yir·dū ḇām yə·šā·rîm lab·bō·qer wə·ṣī·rå̄m lə·ḇal·lō·wṯ šə·’ō·wl miz·zə·ḇul lōw
verses.literal: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol Death will be their shepherd The upright will rule them in the morning and their form will decay in Sheol far from their lofty abode
verses.literalPt: Como ovelhas são encurralados no Sheol; a morte os pastoreia. Os justos dominam sobre eles de manhã; a sua formosura, consumi-la-á o Sheol, para não ter mais lugar onde habite.

verses.original: אַךְ־ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִפְדֶּ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִֽיַּד־ שְׁא֑וֹל כִּ֖י יִקָּחֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm yip̄·deh nap̄·šî mî·yaḏ- šə·’ō·wl kî yiq·qā·ḥê·nî se·lāh
verses.literal: But God will redeem my life from Sheol for He will surely take me to Himself Selah
verses.literalPt: Mas Deus remirá a minha alma do poder do Sheol, pois ele me receberá. (Selá)

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭ירָא כִּֽי־ יַעֲשִׁ֣ר אִ֑ישׁ כִּֽי־ יִ֝רְבֶּה כְּב֣וֹד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā kî- ya·‘ă·šir ’îš kî- yir·beh kə·ḇō·wḏ bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich when the splendor of his house increases
verses.literalPt: Não temas, quando alguém se enriquecer, quando for aumentada a glória da sua casa,

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְ֭מוֹתוֹ יִקַּ֣ח הַכֹּ֑ל לֹא־ יֵרֵ֖ד אַחֲרָ֣יו כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ḇə·mō·w·ṯōw yiq·qaḥ hak·kōl lō- yê·rêḏ ’a·ḥă·rāw kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw
verses.literal: For when he dies he will carry nothing away . . . his abundance will not follow him down
verses.literalPt: porque, quando morrer, não levará coisa alguma; a sua glória não descerá após ele.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּ֣יו יְבָרֵ֑ךְ וְ֝יוֹדֻ֗ךָ כִּי־ תֵיטִ֥יב לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nap̄·šōw bə·ḥay·yāw yə·ḇā·rêḵ wə·yō·w·ḏu·ḵā kî- ṯê·ṭîḇ lāḵ
verses.literal: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul and men praise you when you prosper
verses.literalPt: Ainda que ele, enquanto vivo, abençoou a sua alma (Os homens te louvam, enquanto fazes o bem a ti mesmo.),

verses.original: תָּ֭בוֹא עַד־ דּ֣וֹר אֲבוֹתָ֑יו עַד־ נֵ֝֗צַח לֹ֣א יִרְאוּ־ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: tā·ḇō·w ‘aḏ- dō·wr ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāw ‘aḏ- nê·ṣaḥ lō yir·’ū- ’ō·wr
verses.literal: he will join . . . the generation of his fathers who will never . . . . . . see the light of day
verses.literalPt: irá ter com a geração de seus pais, os quais não verão mais a luz.

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר וְלֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām bî·qār wə·lō yā·ḇîn nim·šal kab·bə·hê·mō·wṯ niḏ·mū
verses.literal: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish
verses.literalPt: O homem, revestido de dignidade, mas sem entendimento, é semelhante aos animais que perecem.
